courses.subject: RBT
courses.title: Gateway to Robotics
courses.description: Explore math, hardware, and programming needed for advanced robotics. Discuss hardware; programming; modeling and control; sensing, perception, and control; and AI and machine learning. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
